skill: Python unit testing for small data-processing functions

capabilities.title: Write a Python function and run a script
Write and run a deterministic unit test
Isolate a dependency and test both output and calls

lessons.title: 写出第一个可解释的单元测试
lessons.exercise: 为 normalize_scores 编写正常输入与边界值测试；再修改一个预期值，观察测试失败。
lessons.output: my_tests/test_normalize.py and a short explanation of a deliberately failing assertion.
exit_criteria: Explain arrange, act, and assert on your own test.
Run at least three independently written tests and explain one intentional failure.

lessons.title: 用错误输入检验实现边界
lessons.exercise: 从空白测试文件检查空列表、布尔值、字符串、非有限值、越界值和合法浮点数；先说明为何应接受或拒绝。
lessons.output: An independently written invalid-input suite and one regression-test explanation.
exit_criteria: Differentiate a wrong input type from an out-of-range numeric value.
Make a deliberate validation mutation and demonstrate that your test catches it.

lessons.title: 隔离数据来源并迁移到新问题
lessons.exercise: 用 Mock 替代 loader，测试成功、超时和非法数据；随后实现并测试一个新的 median_from_loader。
lessons.output: my_tests/test_loader.py, median_from_loader, and one paragraph distinguishing unit and integration testing.
exit_criteria: Verify both returned value and loader invocation count.
Test propagation of TimeoutError without making a network request.
Pass independently designed odd/even-length median cases.

notes: Illustrative 4-hour planning estimate, not a guarantee of mastery. A learner is assumed to know basic Python. This is not a full RAG course.
